head: codex/5691-runtime-v3-vector-otel
title: Implement Runtime v3 Vector OTEL master logging (#5691)
body:
## Summary

Implements #5691 production Runtime v3 tracing through the existing tracing facade into one pinned Vector pipeline, with durable canonical master JSONL output, a deterministic `adl.runtime.master_log_audit.v1` auditor report for WP-12 consumption, startup signal registration before API readiness, fail-closed Vector child liveness supervision, tracing-subscriber span correlation, redaction, bounded buffering/drain behavior, OTLP configuration, and repo-native macOS/Linux/Windows Vector provisioning.

This does not claim WP-12 10K or soak acceptance; those runs remain gated until this Vector-backed logging path is integrated.
